turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: In this module we will talk about reading with fluency.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Bonke o-teacher bafisa ukubona abafundi babo befinyelela ezigabeni zokufunda ngokugeleza bangalokhu bebala amagama.
turns.en: All teachers wish to see their learners reaching the stages of reading with fluency without keeping on spelling words.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ngakho ke kubalulekile ukuthi sisebenzise izilinganiso uma befunda ukuze befunde ngokuyikho, ngokushesha, besebenzisa iphimbo ngendlela efanele.
turns.en: Therefore it is important that we use measures when they read so that they read correctly, quickly, using the voice in the correct way.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda umsebenzi wale-module, uzokwazi ukukhombisa ulwazi lokuthi kuyini ukufunda ngokugeleza nokuthi ungakufundisa kanjani eklasini.
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module, you will be able to show knowledge of what reading with fluency is and how you can teach it in the classroom.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukukhombisa umbhalo ofanele ozokwenza abafundi bathuthuke ekufundeni ngokugeleza,
turns.en: To show the appropriate text that will make learners progress in reading with fluency,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: nokwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola eyahlukene ezokwazi ukuveza amazinga ahlukene okufunda ngokugeleza abafundi abakuwo.
turns.en: and to do different assessment activities that will be able to show the different levels of reading with fluency that the learners are at.
